summary: Iran has reportedly transitioned from a defensive to a full offensive posture, setting a deadline for the implementation of a memorandum of understanding with the US. Tensions are escalating as the 60-day Islamabad agreement between Iran and the US has expired without a specific agreement. Concurrently, reports indicate US officials are considering a nuclear strike on Iran due to the expiration of peace agreements.
key_points: Iran has reportedly decided to shift from a defensive posture to a full offensive posture (Source: @New_security8200).
Iran has set a deadline of several weeks for the full implementation of a memorandum of understanding with the US (Source: @New_security8200).
The 60-day period of the Islamabad agreement between Iran and the US has expired without a specific agreement being reached (Source: @mamlekate).
High-ranking IRGC generals reportedly held secret online meetings with Hezbollah, Houthi, and pro-Iranian militia commanders to discuss expanding the war (Source: @asafroz/52508).
The US is reportedly considering a nuclear strike on Iran following the expiration of peace agreements (Source: @kianmeli1).
The Israeli Prime Minister's office claims an agreement was reached with the Gaza Peace Council regarding Hamas disarmament (Source: @SharghDaily/178589).
Yemeni Armed Forces targeted a Saudi military vessel and four escorting boats in the Red Sea near Al Mokha using ballistic missiles (Source: @presstv/203166).
The US is focusing on economic pressure on Iran, though officials note Iran shows little interest in US-preferred terms (Source: @SharghDaily/178589).

sections.executive_summary: Iran has declared a shift to a full offensive posture and set a multi-week deadline for US negotiations. The expiration of the 60-day Islamabad agreement has increased the risk of wider conflict. US officials are reportedly considering nuclear options in response to these developments.

points: Iran has officially decided to transition from a defensive military posture to a full offensive posture (Source: @New_security8200).
The 60-day deadline for the Islamabad agreement between Iran and the United States has expired without a specific agreement being reached (Source: @mamlekate).
IRGC generals have reportedly held secret online discussions with commanders from Hezbollah, the Houthis, and other pro-Iranian militias to discuss expanding the war (Source: @asafroz/52508).
Iran has reportedly set a deadline of several weeks for the full implementation of a memorandum of understanding with the United States (Source: @New_security8200).

The Israeli Prime Minister's office claims an agreement with the Gaza Peace Council to form working groups focused on the disarmament of Hamas (Source: @SharghDaily/178589).
The agreement stipulates that Israel will only conduct strikes to remove immediate threats and return to the original 'yellow line' (Source: @almogboker78/17980).
Hamas official Khalil al-Hayya met with Mohammed Deif in Cairo to discuss the second phase of a ceasefire in Gaza (Source: @N12chat/222351).
An official Knesset report indicates a dramatic decline in Israelis returning to occupied territories due to the ongoing conflict in Gaza (Source: @presstv/203174).
The Gaza Peace Council agreement requires Hamas to completely disarm of all light and heavy weapons and tunnels (Source: @almogboker78/17980).
Hamas has committed to an immediate cessation of all military activity in Gaza, including rearmament and tunnel digging (Source: @almogboker78/17980).
Israel maintains the right to act if Hamas returns to terrorism or attempts to re-arm (Source: @almogboker78/17980).
Warplanes have been flying over Lebanon, necessitating extreme caution (Source: @redlinkleb/37113).
The Mq9 channel is providing real-time maps and warnings for the Lebanese region (Source: @redlinkleb/37087).
Iraqi sources reported a major fire at a fuel storage tank located in Sulaymaniyah, northern Iraq (Source: @presstv/203177).
The Iranian Parliament Speaker, Qalibaf, is scheduled to visit Baghdad next Wednesday (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385339).
Yemeni Armed Forces used ballistic missiles to strike a Saudi military vessel and four escorting boats off the coast of Al Mokha in the Red Sea (Source: @presstv/203166).
The US is currently focusing on applying economic pressure on Iran (Source: @SharghDaily/178589).

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level is high due to Iran's transition to an offensive posture and the expiration of the Islamabad agreement. The potential for US military action, including nuclear options, increases the risk of direct confrontation. Coordination between IRGC and regional militias like Hezbollah and the Houthis suggests a coordinated effort to expand the conflict.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are engaging in diplomatic efforts, such as the discussions between Iran and Turkey regarding the Strait of Hormuz. The US is maintaining economic pressure on Iran, while the Yemeni Houthis continue to target Saudi vessels in the Red Sea.
sections.intelligence_notes: The expiration of the 60-day US-Iran agreement has removed a primary diplomatic buffer. The reported secret meetings between IRGC and regional militias indicate a high level of operational synchronization for potential escalation.
